annotations.title: CVE search by product or keyword (NVD)

description: CVE search by product or keyword (NVD) — Find the newest CVEs for a product, vendor or keyword from the NIST National Vulnerability Database, newest first, with CVSS (v4.0/3.1/3.0/2 fallback), CWE, CISA Known-Exploited flag + due date, affected product version ranges, patch/exploit references and a verdict (ACT NOW / REVIEW / MONITOR / NONE FOUND). Params: q (keyword, all words must match) or cpe (CPE 2.3 prefix like cpe:2.3:a:apache:http_server); optional days (published in the last N days, max 120), severity (LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH|CRITICAL, CVSS v3), kev=1 (only CISA KEV), limit (1-20, default 10). For a single CVE id use /v1/security/cve. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: security_cve_search
